steps.title: Sketch the side profile
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the front).
Line: draw the five sided outline starting at the origin.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): 70 long, 50 high, 20 high at the right hand end, the slope 30 across and 30 up (45 degrees). Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the block
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 40 mm, into the screen. Click OK.

steps.title: Drill a hole square to the slope
actions: Click Hole and click the sloping face. Inventor drills square to the face you pick.
Position the centre in the middle of the face: half way along the slope and 20 from the front edge.
Type: Simple Hole. Diameter 12 mm. Termination: Distance, 30 mm. Drill Point: Flat. Click OK.
steps.note: Look at the front view: the hole is not seen as a circle until you add an auxiliary view square to the slope.
